name: Salvatore De Meo - Proposition de résolution (ensemble du texte)
title: REPORT on the implementation of the EU agri-food promotion policy
part_text:
**What the report asks for**

This report is the European Parliament's opinion, not a new law. It asks the European Union to keep paying for campaigns that promote European farm and food products, inside the EU and abroad. It wants the budget kept at least at the 2026 level of 205 million euros, after the Commission proposed cuts for 2027. It also asks for simpler paperwork, easier access for small farms, and more support for products with protected regional names.

**Key points**

- The Parliament asks to keep promotion funding at least at 2026 levels and to simplify application rules, especially for small farms.
- It affects farmers, producer groups, cooperatives and food companies that apply for EU promotion money.
- Next, the Commission and EU governments respond; the Parliament has no power here to change the law itself.
